description: This file defines a validation pipeline behavior class for use with MediatR in an ASP.NET Core application. It performs validation of request objects using FluentValidation validators before proceeding with request handling.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior class for validating requests using a set of FluentValidation validators before processing the request.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes validation logic on the request; throws a ValidationException if validation fails; otherwise, continues to the next handler.
